instances.description:
ASSORTED VEGETABLE SET
The set includes a cutting board, knife, and 5 sliceable veggies - tomato, mushroom, shallot, bell pepper, and cucumber. Tactile details offer realistic play.

DINING ROOM - CLASSIC
Children can enjoy decorating their dollhouse with the Classic set of furniture while developing their imagination and creating more interest time.

FISHING GAME
Gone fishin'! The set includes 6 colorful fish, pond-blue fabric, and 2 fishing rods. Rods can be adjusted from beginner to advanced level.
